title: Improving In-Context Learning with Reasoning Distillation
authors_zh: Nafis Sadeq, Xin Xu, Zhouhang Xie, Julian McAuley, Byungkyu Kang, Prarit Lamba, Xiang Gao
paper_type_zh: 推理数据构造与监督微调论文
best_for_zh: 研究推理记录如何进入后训练的读者。
one_line: ReDis distils rule generation and rule following into smaller models for inductive in-context learning.
ReDis 将规则生成和规则遵循蒸馏到较小模型中，以改善归纳式上下文学习。
why: It makes a reasoning-data consumption decision explicit.
inclusion_reason: It changes how reasoning records are selected, structured, or consumed by supervised post-training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Language models often follow the semantic priors of pretraining when given few-shot demonstrations. On inductive tasks, a model must infer the rule connecting inputs and outputs before applying it to a new input; imitating a teacher’s final answer alone can leave that hidden rule unlearned.

The paper asks how a student can acquire this two-stage behavior from a teacher when the underlying rule is not labeled. It treats candidate hypotheses, their agreement with demonstrations, and the resulting rule-following answer as training material rather than as an unobserved inference-time trick.

语言模型在少样本示例下常依赖预训练的语义先验；在归纳任务中，模型必须先推断输入与输出间的规则，再将其用于新输入。只模仿教师的最终答案，可能使这一隐藏规则没有被学到。

论文追问在规则本身没有标注时，学生如何从教师获得这种两阶段行为；它把候选假设、假设与示例的一致性及由此得到的规则遵循答案视为训练材料，而非不可见的推理技巧。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ReDis constructs records for both rule generation and rule following. A teacher produces candidate natural-language hypotheses, and a hypothesis is scored by how many demonstrations it satisfies; that score supplies a filter for SFT and a preference signal for alignment.

The key idea is to train the student on the latent reasoning interface, not merely on outputs. The method couples augmented demonstrations with filtered hypotheses and then aligns the student so it can use a smaller hypothesis search space at inference time.

ReDis 为规则生成和规则遵循构造记录。教师产生候选自然语言假设，假设满足的示例数量构成评分，并为 SFT 过滤和偏好对齐提供信号。

关键在于训练学生掌握潜在推理接口，而不只训练输出。方法把增广示例与被过滤的假设结合，再对齐学生，使其能在推理时使用较小的假设搜索空间。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline has three stages: teacher-driven data augmentation, SFT on rule generation plus rule following, and preference alignment. GPT-4o serves as teacher; the study compares alignment objectives and reports ORPO as the strongest overall option in its setting.

Its released materials cover code, data, and checkpoints. The experiments use LLaMA-3, Mistral, and Qwen students on 1D-ARC, List Function, ACRE, and MiniSCAN, so the training consumer is explicit: generated hypotheses and filtered demonstrations are consumed by SFT and preference alignment.

流水线包含教师驱动的数据增广、规则生成与遵循的 SFT，以及偏好对齐。GPT-4o 是教师；论文比较了对齐目标，并报告 ORPO 在其设置中整体最强。

发布材料涵盖代码、数据和检查点。实验使用 LLaMA-3、Mistral 与 Qwen 学生，在 1D-ARC、List Function、ACRE 和 MiniSCAN 上评估，因此训练消费者明确：生成假设和过滤示例进入 SFT 与偏好对齐。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For a LLaMA-3 ReDis model, the paper reports relative gains over GPT-4o of 23.2% on 1D-ARC, 2.8% on ACRE, and 66.6% on MiniSCAN within a similar hypothesis search space. It also reports token-efficiency gains of 87%, 53%, and 25% on MiniSCAN, 1D-ARC, and ACRE.

These results support the method on the stated synthetic and inductive tasks, and the ablations connect filtering and preference alignment to the outcome. They do not establish that teacher-generated rules are equally reliable for open-ended natural-language tasks or that the same preference recipe transfers without an explicit rule-consistency check.

对于 LLaMA-3 ReDis，论文报告其在相近假设搜索空间中相对 GPT-4o 在 1D-ARC、ACRE、MiniSCAN 上分别提升 23.2%、2.8%、66.6%，并报告相应的词元效率收益。

这些结果支持方法在所述合成归纳任务上的作用，消融也把过滤和偏好对齐与结果联系起来；它们并不证明教师规则在开放自然语言任务中同样可靠。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior distillation commonly teaches a student to imitate answers or long traces. ReDis changes the training record by making a candidate rule and its demonstration-consistency score first-class objects, then uses them for both corpus filtering and preference construction.

Its novelty is therefore the rule-level supervision interface and the link from a noisy teacher hypothesis to a measurable consistency test. Generic SFT, hypothesis search, and preference optimization are components; the contribution is how they are connected to decide which reasoning records enter training.

既有蒸馏通常让学生模仿答案或长轨迹。ReDis 把候选规则及其示例一致性分数变为一等记录对象，并用于语料过滤与偏好构造。

因此新意是规则级监督接口，以及把有噪教师假设连接到可测一致性测试。SFT、假设搜索和偏好优化是组件；贡献在于它们如何共同决定哪些推理记录进入训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html: A teacher may propose plausible but wrong rules, and agreement with a small set of demonstrations is not proof of a rule’s general validity. The reported tasks have structured input-output contracts, so reuse on natural-language data needs stronger verification, leakage checks, and an audit of teacher-model dependence.
教师可能提出看似合理却错误的规则，少量示例的一致性也不证明规则可泛化。复用到自然语言数据前需要更强验证、泄漏检查和教师依赖审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ReDis when examples expose a recoverable latent rule and the training pipeline can test a candidate rule against demonstrations. Keep teacher generation, consistency filtering, SFT, and preference alignment as separate ablations; do not treat a high agreement score as ground-truth correctness outside the task contract.
当示例揭示可恢复的潜在规则，且流水线能用示例检验候选规则时，可使用 ReDis。应将教师生成、一致性过滤、SFT 与偏好对齐分别消融。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember the record chain: demonstrations lead to candidate rules, consistency filters the rules, and rule-plus-query records train the student to both hypothesize and apply. The main evidence is not merely better ICL scores but the combination of supervised and preference data derived from an explicit rule test.
记住记录链：示例产生候选规则，一致性过滤规则，规则加查询的记录训练学生提出并应用规则。关键证据是由显式规则测试导出的监督与偏好数据。
